MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Skip safety briefings for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.

   A. Monitor

   C. CPU
